name: Cable Seated Chest Press
steps: Place a bench centered between two chest-height pulleys facing away from the machine.
Sit tall with feet planted and hold a handle beside each side of your chest.
Press both handles straight forward until your arms are nearly straight in front of your chest.
Bend your elbows under control to bring the handles back beside your ribs.
tips: Keep your torso steady against the backward pull.
Keep your shoulder blades down and wrists aligned behind the handles.
